title: Sleep-EDF Expanded: Whole-Night PSG Recordings
description: A BIDS-formatted version of the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF Expanded database, containing 197 whole-night polysomnography recordings. It includes a cassette study of 78 healthy subjects with ambulatory 48-hour recordings and a telemetry study of 22 subjects in a Temazepam drug study. Expert-annotated 30-second sleep stage labels are provided in events files, mapped to AASM stages with the original Rechtschaffen & Kales stages preserved.
methods_description: Recordings include EEG (Fpz-Cz and Pz-Oz at 100 Hz), horizontal EOG and submental EMG, with respiration and temperature in some recordings. Sleep stages were expert-annotated in 30-second epochs. The original S3 and S4 stages were combined into N3 following AASM conventions.
